official_source: National Water Data Portal (NWIC) - River Water Level (Telemetry - Hourly), Goa Department
producer: Goa Department / Department of Water Resources
important_note: The existence of a Goa telemetry dataset does not prove that a telemetry station is located on the Dudhsagar River. Station-level filtering and proximity validation are required before using a record as Dudhsagar-specific.
